newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, April 27 - Varna - 37 Vessels operating of which 19 loading, 2 soda, 6 fertiliser, 1 glass, 1 general, 1 kaoline, 1 edc, 1 clinker, 2 quartz sand, 1 wooden material, 1 magnesite, 1 sas, 1 general/containers. 9 Discharging, 3 phosphorite, 2 coal, 2 rice, 1 sugar, 1 wheat. 7 Discharging/loading containers, 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 12 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 to load urea, wooden material, 1 to discharge rice, 2 to 4 containers, 7 cargo not nominated.

CROATIA, April 28 - Pula - One vessel discharging at berth. Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 3 loading at berth, 7 under repair/drydock, 6 due. Delays expected. Zadar - Two vessels under repair/drydock. Split - One vessel under repair/drydock, 3 discharging at berth. Ploce - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth. Dubrovnik - Two vessels awaiting orders. Rasa, Sibenik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, April 29 - Limassol - Vessels due on 30/4, 4 containers, 5 conventional vessels, 5 passenger vessels, no delays expected. 5 Containers discharging/loading at berth, 4 conventional vessels discharging at berth. Larnaca - Vessels due on 30/4, 1 container vessel, 2 conventional vessels, 1 container discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth.

ESTONIA, April 28 - Tallinn - City port - 2 Vessels due, no delays expected. 1 Vessel discharging cellulose at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 liner, 1 awaiting orders. Kopli - 4 Vessels due, no delays expected. 1 Vessel loading sawn timber at berth. Discharging at berth, 2 meat, 1 cocoa beans. Parnu - 6 Vessels due, no delays expected. Loading at berth, 5 peat, 4 timber, 1 wood granules. Muuga - 4 Vessels due, no delays expected. Loading at berth, 1 fuel oil, 1 petroleum, 2 sawn timber, 1 naphta products, 1 fertiliser, 1 container vessel. Discharging at berth, 3 grain, 1 poultry, 1 container vessel.

ITALY, April 29 - Naples - Two vessels berthed, 1 gas tanker, 1 tanker. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Gaeta - One general cargo vessel to berth 30/5, 1 bulker to berth 2/5. Genoa commercial port - 33 Vessels berthed, 5 in drydock, 2 in roads, no delays. Multedo oil harbour - Two berthed, no vessels in roads, no delays. Savona - Five berthed, 1 in roads. Vado Ligure - Two berthed, none in roads, no delays. La Spezia - Eight berthed, 5 under repair/drydock. No vessels in roads, no delays. Leghorn, Augusta oil harbour, Syracuse oil harbour, Venice - No delays. Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona/Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. Sarroch - Eight berthed, 12 in roads. Taranto - One in roads. Ravenna - Eight in roads. Trieste - One in roads. Some delays at Siot oil terminal.

LATVIA, April 29 - Riga - 15 Vessels operating, 5 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 2 tankers, 1 steel loader, 3 frozen food dischargers, 2 waiting. No delays, 19 due. Ventspils - Five operating of which 1 steel loader, 1 mop loader, 3 miscellaneous, 2 waiting. Delays, 12 due. Liepaja - Two operating, no delays, 3 due.
LITHUANIA, April 28 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 cement, 2 fertiliser, 1 metal, 1 sunflower. 3 Discharging fish, 1 loading/discharging, 1 vessel in roads, 29 due.

POLAND, April 29 - Szczecin - 88 Vessels due, 49 loading at berth, 33 discharging, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 8 under repair/drydock. Gdynia - Ten vessels operating of which 6 loading at berth (4 general cargo, 2 bulk). 4 Discharging (2 general cargo, 2 grain), 4 vessels under repair/drydock, 31 due. Gdansk - 11 Vessels operating of which 6 loading at berth (1 bulk, 4 general cargo, 1 coal), 5 discharging (2 tankers, 2 general, 1 bulk), 4 under repair/drydock, 23 due.

PORTUGAL, April 28 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 5 general cargo, 5 container vessels, 2 container vessels awaiting berth totalling 9,402 dwt. Places vacant, 10 piers with cranes, 2 without. Sines - Vessels operating, 1 each discharging coal, crude, 1 loading gasoil/gasoline. Vessels due, 2 to discharge crude, 1 each to discharge chemical naphtha/load tbn, crude, 1 each to load gasoline, butane/propane, butane, butadiene. Setubal - April 29 - Three vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging, 6 under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 5 for discharging, 4 for loading, 1 for repair/drydock. Lisbon - April 29 - 53 Vessels due, 76 in port. 3 Loading at berth, 14 unloading at berth, 7 loading/unloading at berth, 2 loading at anchorage, 2 bunkering. 13 Under repair/drydock, 6 awaiting orders, 22 miscellaneous craft.

ROMANIA, April 30 - Constanta - 39 Vessels operating of which 23 generals, 4 bulkers, 5 chemicals, 1 tanker, 3 cement, 2 containers. 5 In roads of which 2 generals, 2 bulkers. Constanta Sud (Agigea) - Seven operating, 5 generals, 2 bulkers. Mangalia - No vessels. Midia - Three vessels loading livestock.

RUSSIA, April 28 - BALTIC PORTS - Kaliningrad - Commercial sea port - 8 Vessels operating of which 7 loading (3 non-ferrous metals, 2 coke, 1 ferro-alloys, 1 paper reels). 1 Discharging/loading trailers, 1 waiting, 4 due. State fishery port - 4 Vessels operating of which 1 loading oil, 3 discharging (2 frozen fish, 1 animal food), 3 due. April 29 - Kaliningrad - Ten vessels operating, no delays, 3 vessels due. Vyborg - Two vessels operating, no delays, 4 vessels due. St. Petersburg - 14 vessels operating of which loading 3 non-ferrous, 5 fertiliser, 1 coal, 1 cellulose. Discharging, 1 each frozen fish, containers, frozen meat, bananas. 7 Vessels awaiting operations, 5 vessels due. Large vessels passing without convoy by icebreaker recommendation. Small vessels passing in convoy.

April 29 - FAR EAST ports - Vladivostok - 18 Vessels in port of which 2 passenger vessels, 8 loading (5 metal, 1 timber, 1 soya, 1 ore), 1 general cargo discharging, 1 container vessel discharging/loading, 6 waiting. Nakhodka - 13 Vessels in port of which 1 passenger vessel, 7 loading (3 metal, 4 timber), 1 coke discharging, 4 waiting. Vostochniy - Six vessels in port of which 5 loading (1 timber, 3 coal, 1 clinker). Posyet, Zarubino - No vessels, no delays or congestion in ports.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - Nineteen operating of which 13 loading, 2 scrap, 6 steel, 1 copper, 1 urea, 1 aluminium, 1 saltpetre, 1 paper/equipment. 6 Discharging, 2 rice, 2 sugar, 1 copper, 1 oranges. 30 Vessels waiting in roads of which 10 to load, 2 scrap, 2 steel, 2 paper, 1 cellulose, 1 wood, 1 aluminium, 1 zinc. 20 To discharge, 11 sugar, 4 rice, 1 bananas, 1 citrus, 1 equipment, 1 luggage, 1 container vessel. 34 Vessels due of which 31 to load, 2 scrap, 13 steel, 1 tin, 3 aluminium, 1 zinc, 1 lead, 1 copper, 1 metal, 1 paper, 5 coal, 1 urea, 1 saltpetre. 3 To discharge, 1 sugar, 1 maize, 1 barytes/meal. Oil terminal - 4 Vessels berthed for loading of which 2 crude oil, 1 diesel oil, 1 fuel oil. 3 Tankers waiting in roads of which 2 crude, 1 fuel oil. 9 Tankers due to load of which 8 crude, 1 fuel oil. Berths no. 2 will be closed from 6/5 for 23 days for repairs of oil pipes by oil storage facilities. At the same time a scheduled diver inspection of berths 2 and 3 to check condition underwater follow

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Five vessels operating of which 2 alumina, 1 cabotage, 1 apatite, 1 urea. No vessels waiting. 8 Vessels due during the week of which 6 loaders (1 non-ferrous metals, 1 cabotage, 3 apatite, 1 iron ore pellets), 2 alumina dischargers.

SPAIN, April 28 - Tarragona - A strike notice by port stevedores has been announced for the following days 8/5, 9/5, 10/5, 11/5, 12/5, 13/5, 17/5, 18/5 and 19/5 from 0800 hours of the first day to 0800 hours of the next day. April 29 - Cadiz - 17 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ro, 1 clay, 1 sand, 2 semolina, 1 shipbuilding material, 1 tourist, 8 under repair. No delays. Aviles - Five vessels in port of which 3 loading steel products, 2 discharging of which 1 scrap, 1 fuel oil. Gijon - Seven vessels in port of which 4 loading (2 cement, 2 steel products). 3 Discharging (1 coal, 1 cement, 1 sel products). No delays or congestion. Pasajes - April 29 - 16 Vessels in port of which 10 discharging scrap, 1 each discharging fish, magnesite, coils, woodchip, fertiliser, 1 loading steel. No delays.

TURKEY, April 28 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 7 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 2 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro. No berthing delays. Galata - 8 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 14 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. April 29 - Mersin - Seven vessels awaiting orders. 22 Vessels operating of which loading 4 cement, 1 flour, 1 paper, 1 detergent, 1 legumes, 1 marble, 1 glass, 1 chrome ore. Discharging, 1 sugar, 1 sunflower oil, 1 rail, 3 soybean oil, 1 general cargo, 1 palm oil. Loading/discharging, 1 vehicles, 1 container/vehicles, 1 container, 1 vehicles/citrus. Free zone piers - No vessels. Seka - One vessel discharging fertiliser.

UKRAINE, April 29 - Mariupol - Four vessels operating of which 3 loading 1 ammonia saltpetre, 1 steel, 1 sunflowerseed. 1 Vessel discharging sunflower seed. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load 2 sulphur, 1 fire clay, 1 coal. 1 To discharge/load containers. 21 Vessels due of which 12 to load, 6 steel, 2 fire clay, 3 fertiliser, 1 coal. 3 To discharge, 1 sunflower seed, 1 fluorspar, 1 pipes. 4 To discharge/load containers, 2 to discharge/load of which 1 containers/pipes, 1 containers, 1 containers/aluminium. Ilyichevsk - 12 Vessels operating of which 11 loading, 6 steel, 1 pig iron, 2 cotton, 1 alcohol, 1 potash. 1 To discharge/load cotton/containers. 3 Vessels waiting in roads to load steel and pig iron, 11 due of which 6 to load steel, 1 to load equipment, 4 to discharge/load containers.

Mariupol - Seven vessels loading at berth (fertiliser, metal products, sunflowerseed, coal). 1 Sunflower seed reloading to seagoing vessel. 4 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (sulphur, clay, containers), 2 under repairs/drydock, 10 floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur). 20 Vessels due for discharging and loading (sunflowerseed, metal products, clay, fertiliser, coal, containers, fluorspar). Kerch - Six vessels under repair/drydock. Berdiansk - One vessel loading metal products at berth.

YUGOSLAVIA, April 29 - Bar - Six vessels berthed of which 3 discharging gasoline, 1 discharging bananas, 1 each loading metal, acetic acid. Zelenika (Bijela) - Two vessels discharging gasoline, 1 laid up, 1 under repair.
